data.one_liner: A customizable animated dot indicator for PageView widgets.
data.what_it_does: Draws a row of dots representing pages in a PageView. Allows custom colors, sizes, spacing, animation duration and edge fading. Provides an optional click callback for each dot.
use_when: You need a simple visual page indicator for a PageView
You want to customize dot size, color, spacing, or add click handling
avoid_when: You need a full‑featured tab bar or complex pagination UI
You require a non‑dot style indicator
weaknesses: May have performance impact with extremely large page counts
data.minimal_example:
PageViewDotIndicator(
  currentItem: selectedPage,
  count: pageCount,
  unselectedColor: Colors.black26,
  selectedColor: Colors.blue,
  size: const Size(12, 12),
  unselectedSize: const Size(8, 8),
  duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 200),
  margin: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 8),
  alignment: Alignment.centerLeft,
  onItemClicked: (index) { /* handle tap */ },
);
